title: Tour the map
blurb: Unlock all four districts before chasing side content, so every region's activities and collectibles are open to you as you roam.

title: Start the story
blurb: Begin the campaign and follow the opening story beats. Knock out the early story trophies — Just Like Paradise (Gone Fishing), Paradise Lost (Chapter 1) and Trust (Breakfast Run) — then grab the one-off world moments In The Beginning…, Capital Offense and Let’s Go Bowling while their locations are fresh. Do these first to establish your save and unlock the core loop.

title: Chapters and big missions
blurb: Push through the main chapters and set-piece missions, ticking off the chapter trophies — T**s Ass Drug Money (Chapter 2), Vice City, Baby! (Chapter 3) and Top Of The World, Ma (Chapter 4). Stay alert for the story mission trophies — Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked and Snow Storm — and grab any missable moment while its quest is still available.

title: Strangers and side stories
blurb: Turn aside from the main path to help the locals. Clear the stranger mission strands to the end for their closing-mission trophies — Road to Rehabilitation (Andy), This Was No Boat Accident (Kenton), The Lone Rider (Billy), Supply & Demand (Randy) and Spin On This! (Tyrone) — and finish any that pop while available, including Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler, Fair Game and Strangers & Freaks. These can vanish as the story moves on, so grab them now.

title: Explore Leonida
blurb: Sweep the state once you are well settled so you are not backtracking. Hit the world and collectible trophies as you roam — The Goodtime State (all 52 areas), Positive Mental Attitude (18 meditation spots), Don't Touch My Deck (3 card sets), You WAiNKer! (100 WAiNK spots), Whip It Good (100 vehicles), Little Boxes (all 8 garages) and On the Spot (10 Scooter Bros registrations). Travel region by region and clear them as you go.

title: Activities and challenges
blurb: Grind the activity and challenge trophies alongside normal play rather than forcing them at the end. Chase Cunning Stunts (250 stunts), Master of None (all 9 activity types), The Shootist (gold on all 42 shooting range challenges), Top Fun (win every drone race), Earn Cash, Not Kudos (20 different race wins) and One Last Thing (50 challenges). Bump the numbers whenever a natural opportunity presents itself.

title: Crime and the economy
blurb: Handle the crime and economy trophies as the opportunities appear in-game. Do the missable ones early — Hot Together (lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner), Retail Therapy (3 shops back-to-back), Catch Me If You Can (unscheduled departure at VCIA), Personal Best, Bad Luck, I Guess and The Truth Is Out There. Then keep the counts ticking over: Gunslinger, Challenging Tank, Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Pest Control, Ten Pin, Actions Speak Louder, Dime on the Dollar and Treat Yo Self.

title: The road to 100%
blurb: Finish the clean-up run for A Long Road (100% completion), then close out with the final mission You Gotta Know When to Get Off. Any leftover trophies from earlier stages come together here. Last of all, the platinum Vice Got a Price! unlocks the moment the rest of the list is complete — save it for the very end.
